name: mathmover-builder
description: Builds interactive and verifiable GeoGebra models from math problems and natural-language requests.

displayDescription.en: Turns problem images or natural-language requests into interactive, verifiable GeoGebra models for exploring mathematical change.
displayDescription.zh: 将题图或自然语言要求转化为可交互、可验证的 GeoGebra 动态数学图形，帮助观察参数变化。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Build this ellipse problem and let me see how the triangle's area changes.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我构建这个椭圆题，我想直观看到三角形面积的变化。

quickPrompts.en: Build this ellipse problem and let me see how the triangle's area changes.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我构建这个椭圆题，我想直观看到三角形面积的变化。

quickPrompts.en: Build this function problem and let me see how the segment length and triangle change.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我构建这道函数题，我想直观看到线段长度和三角形的变化。

quickPrompts.en: Build this cube and let me see how the triangle's area changes.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我构建这个正方体，我想直观看到三角形面积的变化。
